name: openclaw-openrouter
description: Run your own OpenClaw Gateway on ORB Cloud, backed by OpenRouter so you can pick any model in the OpenRouter catalog (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta, Mistral, DeepSeek, etc.) via OPENROUTER_MODEL. Idle = $0, wake on inbound HTTP in <1s, persistent state across sleep.

required_secrets.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
required_secrets.purpose: OpenRouter API key. Sent to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 via ORB's per-computer LLM proxy.

optional_inputs.name: OPENROUTER_MODEL
optional_inputs.default: (whatever openclaw onboard's wizard picks for the openrouter provider)
optional_inputs.purpose: Pin a specific OpenRouter model as the agent's primary. Leave unset to use the wizard default.

optional_inputs.name: DEPLOY_NAME
optional_inputs.purpose: Identifier for this deploy. Used in DELETE /v1/swarms/<id> for teardown.

exposes.purpose: OpenClaw Gateway — Control UI + RPC API for messages/sessions/agents.

siblings.name: openclaw
siblings.description: Same gateway, locked to Z.AI's GLM Coding Plan as the only LLM upstream — cheaper if you already have a GLM Coding Plan key and don't need model variety.
